# FlyItalyADSB API (flyitalyadsb/adsb-api)

> Free, self-serve ADS-B flight tracking REST API: live aircraft positions as JSON for any point on Earth, from a community network of <!-- sync:receivers:start -->about 3,200<!-- sync:receivers:end --> ADS-B/MLAT receivers (born in Italy in 2020, receivers all over the world, densest in North America and Europe). Free key by email in seconds; commercial use allowed on every plan within its limits, Free included. Data licence CC BY-SA 4.0. This repository holds working examples (curl, Python, Node.js, ESP32), a copy of the OpenAPI 3.1 spec and this summary.

## Essentials

- Base URL: `https://api.flyitalyadsb.com/v2`. Auth: header `X-Api-Key: <key>` on every request. JSON responses.
- Get a key: https://flyitalyadsb.com/en/data/api/?utm_source=github&utm_campaign=adsb-api#api-key (email only, no approval; the same key works for the MCP server).
- Main call: `GET /v2/lat/{lat}/lon/{lon}/dist/{km}` returns `{"now": <unix seconds>, "count", "total", "ac": [ ... ]}`, every aircraft within `km` kilometres (not nautical miles) of the point. Records are readsb aircraft.json: `hex`, `flight` (callsign, space-padded), `r` (registration), `t` (ICAO type), `lat`, `lon`, `alt_baro` (feet, or "ground"), `alt_geom`, `gs` (knots), `track`, `baro_rate` (ft/min), `squawk`, `category`, `dbFlags` (1 military, 2 interesting, 4 PIA, 8 LADD), `type` (position source: adsb_icao, mlat, ...), `seen_pos` (seconds).
- Other endpoints: `/icao/{hex}`, `/callsign/{callsign}`, `/reg/{reg}` (one aircraft object, 404 if not seen now), `/mil`, `/pia`, `/ladd`, `/sqk/{squawk}`, `/type/{type}`, `/profile/{icao}`, `/history/{icao}[/{YYYY-MM-DD}]`, `/overflights?lat=&lon=&dist=&from=&to=`, `/events?lat=&lon=&dist=`, `POST /webhooks` (paid plans).
- Not in the data: routes (departure/arrival airports), airlines, schedules, photos. Unfiltered: military, PIA and LADD aircraft are flagged, not hidden.
- Freshness: rebuilt every 2 s, API reloads at most every 3 s; positions older than ~60 s are not returned.
<!-- sync:coverage:start -->
- Where the receivers are: of those that share their position, about 36% are in the United States, 15% in Germany, 11% in the UK and Ireland and 16% in the rest of Europe; Asia, Australia and New Zealand follow; Latin America and Africa are thinner; Italy is about 3% (October 2026).
<!-- sync:coverage:end -->
- Coverage check without a key: `GET https://api.flyitalyadsb.com/api/coverage?lat=&lon=&radius=` (25/50/100/200 km, 30 requests/min per IP; send a User-Agent of your own), or https://flyitalyadsb.com/en/data/coverage/?utm_source=github&utm_campaign=adsb-api

## Plans (prices before tax, monthly)

<!-- sync:plans:start -->
- Free: €0/month, 30 requests/min per key, 300,000 requests/month, radius up to 500 km.
- Starter: €9/month, 60 requests/min per key, 1,000,000 requests/month, radius up to 1,000 km.
- Pro: €49/month, 300 requests/min per key, 10,000,000 requests/month, no radius limit (the whole world).
- Business: €249/month, 1,000 requests/min per key, 50,000,000 requests/month, no radius limit (the whole world).
- The Free plan also has a cap of 100 requests/min per IP.
- Whole world in one request (`/lat/0/lon/0/dist/20040`): Pro or Business.
<!-- sync:plans:end -->
- Over a limit: 429 (Retry-After) or 403 (radius); refused requests are not counted and never billed. No SLA on any plan; paid plans help cover server and bandwidth costs.
- Feeders (people who run a receiver for the network) get Pro limits on their Free keys at no cost, for non-commercial use: https://flyitalyadsb.com/en/community/feeder/?utm_source=github&utm_campaign=adsb-api
- Reselling the data as an API or feed for other people's products, an SLA, or volume beyond Business: https://flyitalyadsb.com/en/contact/?utm_source=github&utm_campaign=adsb-api
- Current plans: https://flyitalyadsb.com/en/data/api/?utm_source=github&utm_campaign=adsb-api#piani

## Using it in a product

- Allowed on every plan, Free included, in apps and devices you sell. One key per product: all devices, users and servers count on it.
- Your own server may fetch and cache the data to serve your own users (not redistribution). Keep the key on your server when you can: a key in firmware or a web page can be extracted.
- Credit where users see the data: "Flight data: FlyItalyADSB (flyitalyadsb.com), CC BY-SA 4.0". Your code, artwork and design stay yours.
- Rules as Q&A: https://flyitalyadsb.com/en/data/products/using-the-data/?utm_source=github&utm_campaign=adsb-api
- Terms: https://flyitalyadsb.com/en/terms/?utm_source=github&utm_campaign=adsb-api

## AI assistants (MCP)

- MCP server: `https://flyitalyadsb.com/mcp` (Streamable HTTP), official MCP registry name `com.flyitalyadsb/mcp`. OAuth for claude.ai-style connectors, or `X-Api-Key` with the same key.
- Tools: find_aircraft, aircraft_near, special_traffic, aircraft_history, aircraft_profile, overflights, notable_traffic, set_my_location, clear_my_location. Each call counts as one request.
- Guide: https://flyitalyadsb.com/en/data/mcp/?utm_source=github&utm_campaign=adsb-api
